title: AC1027 DBCOLOR self-consistency and independent-evidence output gate
scope: Check locally generated DBCOLOR/NOD capture while keeping DWG-to-DXF DBCOLOR output refused until an independent producer source profile, ACAD_COLOR entry semantics, and fresh DXF readback are established.

localControl.profile: Runtime-generated AC1027 DWG authored with this repository's dwgRW and read with this repository's DWG reader; the scratch DWG is removed by the test and is not a committed fixture.
checks: One DBCOLOR callback is retained in the active import generation with a complete typed capture.
The imported named-object dictionary contains ACAD_COLOR and points it to the locally authored color dictionary handle.
Extension-graph preflight refuses the source with the explicit independent-evidence reason, and a repeated attempt returns the same refusal.
Strict file export refuses and preserves a pre-existing destination byte-for-byte.
limits: Writer and reader are the same implementation; this is only internal self-consistency evidence.
The test does not establish a real producer's DBCOLOR body span, class profile, dictionary key serialization, or external semantic equivalence.
No output DXF is produced, so fresh DXF readback and native color-book behavior remain untested.

findings: Section 2.11 defines CMC fields and entity ENC color references, including the optional AcDbColor handle.
Section 20.4.2 lists the R2004+ color-book color hard-pointer in common entity handle data.
The searchable specification text identifies DBCOLOR as a class-list-dependent object but does not provide a complete DBCOLOR body prescription or ACAD_COLOR dictionary-key serialization.

libreDwg.finding: The independent object schema models DBCOLOR with a common parent and a CMC color field (DXF 62); this corroborates the field family but is not a physical producer sample or interoperability proof.

findings: The database color dictionary contains AcDbColor objects representing color-book colors used by entities.
The getDictionaryKey API documents storage of named colors as AcDbColor objects, but the reviewed documentation does not define the exact serialized entry-key composition.

aresSdk.finding: The SDK reference states that the root drawing dictionary associates ACAD_COLOR with the color dictionary. This supports the root role, not the exact serialized member key or native color-book round trip.

requiredEvidence: A named color-book DWG produced by an independent CAD/ODA-compatible producer, with its version, hash, class mapping, and complete DBCOLOR source frame recorded.
Independent source analysis of body field spans and common owner/reactor/extension roles.
Exact NOD ACAD_COLOR dictionary owner and entry-name-to-DBCOLOR relation from the producer sample.
Typed DXF output and fresh readback comparison for DBCOLOR fields, dictionary entries, and entity color references.
Native color-book display/lookup behavior in an independent consumer.

environment.odaFileConverter: ODA File Converter 27.1.0 ARM64 CLI aborts with PasteBoard/XPC errors while the Mac session is locked; after the user said they were unlocking the session, Computer Use still reported it locked. No independent conversion was obtained.

validation.status: The focused adapter build, all four DBCOLOR-labeled CTests, JSON parse, and whitespace check passed.

nextAction: Keep DBCOLOR output blocked. When an independently produced named-color DWG is available and the ODA/FreeCAD environment is accessible, derive the source profile and exact ACAD_COLOR entry relation, then implement field/reference output and fresh-readback proof as a separate slice.
